text: いちゃもんを　つけられて　おこった　あいては　れんぞくして　おなじ　わざを　つかえなくなる。

structure.jp: いちゃもんを　つけられて　おこった　あいては
structure.en: the foe, angry at being hit with Torment

structure.jp: おなじ　わざを　つかえなくなる。
structure.en: becomes unable to use the same move

patterns.name: 〜なくなる
patterns.explanation: なくなる after a verb says a change happens so that the thing no longer is so; here it follows the 'can use' form. つかえなくなる = 'becomes unable to use'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: This ending says the action is done to someone instead of by them. いちゃもんを　つけられて = 'having Torment used on it'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: いちゃもんを　つけられて　おこった　あいて
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb sits right before a noun and tells you which one. いちゃもんを　つけられて　おこった　あいて = 'the foe that got angry at having Torment used on it'.
